description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.
